sources.snippet: Ouro-1.4B — GGUF GGUF conversions of ByteDance/Ouro-1.4B, a looped language model: the entire 24-layer decoder stack is applied 4 times per token with shared weights, so a 1.4B-parameter model computes at an effective depth of 96 layers.
